title_en: The Tallest Mountain in the Solar System Is 2.5x Everest #Shorts
desc_en:
Olympus Mons on Mars stands 21.9 km high, about 2.5 times Mount Everest, and is roughly 600 km across, about the size of Arizona. It is so broad that standing on it would feel like a gentle slope.

Sources: NASA Photojournal (MOLA height); Space.com.
Directed by L.S.M · Dreamloom Studio (Heosang Gongbang)

#shorts #science
